ELISA.readouts: polysaccharide-specific antibody levels against meningococcal serogroups A and C, including total IgG, IgG1, IgG2, and IgM

evidence_location.quote: Both vaccines induced robust polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody responses against serogroups A and C, as measured by ELISA.

serum bactericidal assay (SBA).readouts: bactericidal antibody titers / serum bactericidal activity against meningococcal serogroups

evidence_location.quote: Both vaccines induced a rapid increase in serum bactericidal activity (SBA), which was detectable as early as day 7, peaked at day 30, began to decline by day 180, yet remained substantially above baseline at day 750 ( Fig. 1d ).

aliases: Measurement of anti-Diphtheria IgG by Luminex

evidence_location.quote: MCV4, which contains the diphtheria toxoid (DT) protein as a conjugate, elicited a strong anti-DT IgG response at days 7 and 30, whereas MPSV4 containing polysaccharide alone did not ( Fig. 1e ).

flow cytometry.readouts: frequency/number of antibody secreting cells (ASCs); in vitro dendritic-cell surface activation markers such as CD80, CD83, HLA-DR, CD86

evidence_location.quote: The number of peripheral blood antibody secreting cells (ASCs) induced by vaccination was assessed. The ASCs showed a peak at day 7 in both vaccines ( Fig. 1f ).

ELISpot.readouts: antigen-specific IgG ASCs to polysaccharide and diphtheria toxoid; total IgG/IgM/IgA secreting cells

evidence_location.quote: Polysaccharide- and DT-specific ELISpots in a subset of MCV4 vaccinees revealed that the majority of IgG ASCs detected in the blood at day 7 were specific for DT ( Supplementary Fig. 1a, b ).

microarray.readouts: transcript abundance / differential gene expression in blood transcriptomes

evidence_location.quote: To gain insights into the molecular mechanisms underlying the responses to meningococcal vaccines, we analyzed the transcriptomic profiles in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC, days 0, 3 and 7) of the vaccinees using DNA microarrays ( Table 1 ).
Consistent with this, analysis of plasma cytokines revealed little change induced by either vaccine ( Supplementary Fig. 3 ).

ELISA kits.sample_type: human myeloid DC and monocyte-derived DC culture supernatants; mouse CD11c+ DC culture supernatants
ELISA kits.readouts: secreted cytokine protein levels including IL-6, TNF, IL-12p40, and IL-1b

evidence_location.quote: Up-regulation of co-stimulatory molecules and secretion of IL-6, TNF and IL-12p40 was detected in human DCs stimulated by MPSV4 ( Fig. 6a ).
